name: Bosch
title: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015- Investor Presentation

read.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 28.2% Q-o-Q to ₹76,551m with EBITDA up 23.2%, driven by PC/CV Power Solutions and pre-festive 2W demand; deck gives no capacity, utilisation or capex data.

triggers.label: Q2 revenue +28.2% Q-o-Q
triggers.quote: Revenue from operations for Q2 grew +28.2% Q-o-Q

triggers.label: RBIC acquired as wholly-owned subsidiary
triggers.quote: Wholly-owned Subsidiary of Bosch Limited (w.e.f. July 01, 2026)

red_flags.label: Raw material cost increase and adverse forex hitting margins
red_flags.quote: partly offset by increase in raw material costs

growth.why: The brief gives only a Q-o-Q revenue increase of 28.2% with no guidance, capacity plans, utilisation figure or management commentary, so no forward growth backing can be assessed.
